name: @neuropause/solution-packs
description: NeuroPause Desktop Industry Integration Layer (IP-02) — a pure, dependency-light adapter that projects the canonical @neuropause/industry platform (SDK, 20 packs, config, low-code, copilots, compliance, connectors, analytics, governance) into desktop/mobile view-models, plus a desktop-local pack enable-state helper. Does NOT re-implement the Industry SDK/registry/config/marketplace.
